name: Key Set Position
hint: The finder detects a key-driven handler that assigns an absolute position on the corresponding axis instead of applying relative movement. Repeated key presses therefore snap the actor to the same coordinate rather than moving it by the intended amount.
instruction: Use a change-x or change-y block, or calculate the next coordinate from the current position; keep continuous key polling when movement should continue while a key is held.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when [right arrow v] key pressed
set x to (10)

examples.label: Possible solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <key (right arrow v) pressed?> then
change x by (10)
end
end
